description: This source file defines the IMembershipService interface and the IndirectProbeResponse struct within the Orleans runtime system, specifying methods for membership change notifications, liveness probes, and indirect probing responses.

classes.name: IndirectProbeResponse
classes.description: Represents the result of probing a node via an intermediary, including health score, success status, response time, and failure message.

methods.name: MembershipChangeNotification
methods.description: Notifies the system about changes in the membership table.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Checks the liveness of a silo, given a unique ping number.

methods.name: ProbeIndirectly
methods.description: Performs an indirect probe of a silo, returning an IndirectProbeResponse.
